post.summary: Change assignment status

Allowed: pending|overdue → in_progress|completed|cancelled; in_progress → completed|cancelled. Agents may only move their own assignments to in_progress/completed. `reason` is required for cancellation. Invalid transitions return `409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION`.

**Roles: admin, manager, agent**

post.description:
Call on app start and when a request fails with `TOKEN_EXPIRED`. Clients must not run refreshes in parallel: re-using an already-rotated cookie revokes the session.

post.summary: Upload a batch of GPS samples for the active shift
post.description:
Send samples every 5–10 s (or queue them while offline and upload later, oldest first). Idempotent per `(sessionId, seq)`: re-sending a batch after a timeout is safe. Samples are rejected when timestamped in the future (> 2 min skew), older than 24 h, or before the shift started. `409 SHIFT_NOT_ACTIVE` means the session ended — start a new shift.

**Roles: agent**
